newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA COURT RULES PRIVATE CRYSTALBANK INSOLVENT.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA COURT RULES PRIVATE CRYSTALBANK INSOLVENT.

text.p: The regional court in the Bulgarian town of Smolyan has ruled private Crystalbank insolvent at the request of the Bulgarian National Bank (BNB), a court official said on Wednesday.
"The court certified that Crystalbank has been insolvent since November 28, 1995 and ruled it bankrupt," the official told Reuters.
Madan-based Crystalbank is the first to be declared bankrupt of the 15 local state and private banks whose insolvency has been sought by the BNB since May last year.
The court based its decision on the fact that Crystalbank had some 953 million levs in outstanding payments as of June 20, 1996.
Its assets totalled around 2.1 billion levs as of May 31 last year against debts to creditors amounting to some 2.6 billion levs, the court said.
Crystalbank owed $1.2 million in principal and interest to the BNB as of March 31 last year.
The BNB cancelled the licence of Crystalbank in March last year due to deep liquidity problems dating back to 1993 and violation of BNB regulations and the banking law.
The central bank sought its insolvency three months later and appointed sequestrators. -- Sofia Newsroom +359-2 981 4145
